name: Markup
description: Crop, draw on, pixelate and label screenshots or any image, in its own window.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Edits screenshots and other images in its own window: crop, draw, add arrows, shapes and text, and pixelate private details.
rules: Opens from a screenshot's Edit button, or with an image you choose.
Copy the result or save it as a new file.
